items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: He called him Bubba. And Irma, she called him Lester. ... He and Lee and Irma had an act they did together.

ctx.x: Yeah. He called him Bubba. And Irma, she called him Lester.
Irma, Lester's sister, called him Lester.

items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: She was there. Roy's wife, too.

ctx.x: What about his wife? Where was his wife living?
She was there. Roy's wife, too. The kid, too.
